label: heart-s6
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Two small modifiers inside gate 1213 have clinically odd signs (thal:7 and fbs:1 both make the block more protective); reported, not interpreted. 8 inputs with no phenotype edges (cp:1, trestbps, restecg:0/1/2, thalach, exang:1, thal:3) are root entries with zero effect; without them structural coverage was 0.742.
tool_bugs: Root composition validation requires child_annotation_ids as annotation names, not ann_N ids. get_formula shows output as ReLU. Heatmap viz summary on multi-exit leaf only gives first-two-entry correlation; sex x exang table computed locally on train.
summary: Mostly logistic regression: 14 direct edges (logit SD 3.42, train AUC 0.926 alone). One nonlinear block (logit SD 1.04): a two-gate sex x exercise-angina interaction; gate 1213 scores 'female without exercise angina' (read out -0.760), gate 47 fires for no-angina patients with low 1213 score (mostly men) and adds +0.384. Exercise angina has no direct edge, so its whole effect runs through this block. Block adds +0.020 train AUC (0.926 -> 0.946). slope:1 term (3660) is an inert affine pass-through.
